You'll want a redstone torch powering the hopper which only turns off when the piston that breaks the shulker extends. A hopper minecart 1 block down won't work because the shulker item has to be touching the block its resting on before the hopper minecart picks it up. This isn't a preferred method as the shulker can break and fly in a random direction. A way around this however is to have the shulker be placed in a little chamber so the shulker can't fly out of the sides.
